info.title: Kunveno public REST API
info.description: Independent external and Leptos frontends use this REST/JSON API and authenticated SSE; no frontend-specific server functions. All business mutations return an asynchronous operation reference. JSON fields are camelCase; enum values are PascalCase. KVN amounts are exact decimal strings in integer token units. Both browser clients send credentials: include and X-CSRF-Token from SessionView for authenticated mutations. Configure an exact Origin allowlist; wildcard credentialed CORS is forbidden. Default cookie is kunveno_session, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Path=/api, 24 hours, Secure outside local HTTP. Separate same-site origins are supported; unrelated cross-site deployment needs an explicit TLS/cookie policy, not relaxed defaults. HTTP errors are ApiError; asynchronously rejected business actions appear in OperationView. No public route accepts raw signatures, signable bytes, nonces, arbitrary provider commands or actor spoofing. Local proof of concept only; no production funds or keys.

servers.description: Same-origin Nginx deployment; external frontends configure their backend base URL independently.

get.summary: Stream session-owned notifications with replay
get.description: Authenticated SSE. Event name: notification; id: adapter notificationId; data: one JSON NotificationView. Last-Event-ID overrides after; both must be valid unsigned cursors when used. Reconnect with the last received ID; do not mark a notification read merely because it arrives. Exact replay is allowed, so deduplicate by notificationId. Use EventSource(url, { withCredentials: true }) across allowed origins. SSE is a delivery channel, not the only way to read an operation outcome.

200.description: Long-lived event stream with buffering disabled. Data frames contain NotificationView JSON.

Cache-Control.description: Prevents caching of session-owned event data.

sessionCookie.name: kunveno_session
sessionCookie.description: Opaque session set by registration/login. HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Path=/api; 24-hour lifetime. Browser fetch uses credentials: include.

csrfToken.name: X-CSRF-Token
csrfToken.description: Exact session-bound token from SessionView; required together with sessionCookie on authenticated mutations.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Client-generated operation identity. Reuse unchanged for retries of the same authenticated typed action; different content conflicts. Keep the same key after uncertain transport outcomes. Omission lets the adapter generate one but cannot deduplicate an unacknowledged retry.

After.description: Exclusive adapter notification cursor. Defaults to 0; not a provider event cursor.

LastEventId.name: Last-Event-ID
LastEventId.description: Last received adapter notification ID, a u64 decimal string. Overrides after. Native EventSource sends it on reconnection.

KvnAmount.description: Strictly positive KVN integer token units. Asset 1 only.

SkillRoleAssociation.description: Descriptive metadata only; assignments do not match by role.

ceremonyId.description: Opaque, single-use challenge reference; expires after five minutes.

options.description: WebAuthn creation options from the server; pass them to a compatible browser WebAuthn JSON helper.

ceremonyId.description: Opaque, single-use challenge reference; expires after five minutes.

options.description: WebAuthn request options from the server; pass them to a compatible browser WebAuthn JSON helper.

credential.description: JSON-serialized WebAuthn credential returned by the browser; the server validates challenge, RP, origin, signature and user verification.

contactEmail.description: Private, unverified contact email; never used for authentication or exposed in public profiles. Optional on writes; missing/null clears it. At most 254 UTF-8 bytes; one @ with nonempty parts, no whitespace or control characters.

AccountId32.description: 32-byte identifier. Requests also accept unprefixed hexadecimal; responses use lowercase 0x-prefixed hexadecimal.

EntityId.description: 16-byte identifier. Requests also accept unprefixed hexadecimal; responses use lowercase 0x-prefixed hexadecimal.

PrincipalId.description: 16-byte identifier. Requests also accept unprefixed hexadecimal; responses use lowercase 0x-prefixed hexadecimal.

OperationId.description: 16-byte identifier. Requests also accept unprefixed hexadecimal; responses use lowercase 0x-prefixed hexadecimal.

ProviderInstanceId.description: 16-byte identifier. Requests also accept unprefixed hexadecimal; responses use lowercase 0x-prefixed hexadecimal.

Money.description: Exact integer KVN token units, from 0 through 18446744073709551615. Canonical decimal string, no sign, leading zero, fraction, or implicit decimal display scale.

Minutes.description: Non-negative integer minutes. Display conversion to hours is a frontend concern.

UnixSeconds.description: Non-negative UTC Unix timestamp in whole seconds; preserve exact integer.

Revision.description: Provider-owned revision starting at zero, incremented with checked arithmetic. Accept the revision actually reviewed; do not refresh it silently.

Week.description: Validated ISO week-year and week. Week 53 is valid only for ISO years that contain it, and the date must be representable by the provider calendar. ISO year is not necessarily the calendar year.

WeekWindow.description: Inclusive scheduling window. End must not precede start. Capacity is reserved from earliest available weekly buckets inside the window.

ProviderOperationStatus.description: 202 is durable acceptance, not execution success. OutcomeUnknown is unresolved submission, never evidence of rejection. Finalized must be interpreted with receipt.outcome.

Qualifications.description: Every referenced role/skill must exist. Roles remain metadata; assignment intersects all requirement skill IDs.

CalendarDefinition.description: At most one override per week. Missing overrides use the default indefinitely. Changes must preserve reservations and may not reduce capacity below committed minutes.

RegisterWorkerRequest.description: Registers the authenticated account in Worker mode and creates its owned calendar. It cannot grant coordinator eligibility.

FundAccountRequest.description: Administrator-only mock funding; requires provider mock-seed feature. Never a production faucet.

ScorePolicy.description: Integer percentages must sum to exactly 100. Initial policy is 50/50.

CreateProjectRequest.description: Client and eligible coordinator are derived by the backend, never selected through spoofed actor fields.

PlanningQuote.description: Fixed planning fee plus committed planning duration/window. Does not start planning or authorize a transfer before client acceptance.

RevisionRequest.description: Planning acceptance and delivery use PlanningView.revision. Execution approval uses ProposalView.revision. A mismatch fails with revision_conflict before business effects.

RequirementDefinition.description: One person/slot. Keys must be unique inside the milestone; assignment requires every skill. Role is retained but not matched.

MilestoneDefinition.description: Checked total equals coordinatorFee plus every requirement budget. Distinct slots in this milestone receive distinct workers.

ProposalDefinition.description: Milestone keys must be unique. Provider creates one attached task storage per milestone; callers cannot supply its identity.

ReasonRequest.description: Cancellation/dispute freezes unreleased funds; this text is not an instruction to refund or pay.

TaskDefinition.description: Task tracking does not change contractual assignments, reservations, or payout amounts. Task IDs, reporter, and timestamps are provider-owned. Omitted dueAt and null both mean no due date.

TaskProgressRequest.description: The only changes an assigned worker can make to task tracking.

RequestMilestoneCompletionRequest.description: Exactly one rating for each contractually assigned worker, without duplicate worker accounts.

TeamRating.description: Client gives one team score, or delegates each worker rating to the coordinator without inventing a client vote.

AcceptMilestoneCompletionRequest.description: Client acceptance settles quoted payments and contributes mode-specific reputation once. Reputation weight is committed minutes, not money or edited logged minutes.

Username.description: ASCII username, normalized to lowercase by the adapter.

Password.description: 12 through 1024 UTF-8 bytes, not characters. JSON Schema length counts Unicode characters; the exact byte bound is enforced by the adapter. Never derives a wallet key.

ChangePasswordRequest.description: Changes login credentials without changing the custodial account. Never export a private key.

SessionView.description: Cookie secret is never returned in JSON. Keep csrfToken private and send it as X-CSRF-Token on authenticated mutations.

CatalogEntry.description: Role ID 1 (coordinator) is fixed and cannot be renamed or removed.

weightedScoreSum.description: Exact u128 accumulator, at most 340282366920938463463374607431768211455. Responses are canonical decimal; deserialization also accepts leading zeros.

ratedMinutes.description: Unsigned 64-bit integer. Clients must preserve exact JSON integers; do not round values above JavaScript Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER.

ReputationView.description: Mean score is weightedScoreSum / (100 * ratedMinutes). Unrated score is 5. Use exact rational comparison before display rounding.

PlanningView.description: Planning delivery acceptance is distinct from execution approval and pays only the agreed planning fee.

createdAt.description: Provider creation time in UTC Unix seconds. New projects always have a timestamp. Older snapshots recover it from ProjectCreated events; null means no creation event is available.

completed.description: True after the last milestone is accepted; only one milestone is active at a time.

ProjectView.description: Only visible to authorized project participants. Cancellation freezes unreleased escrow and does not reverse completed transfers.

BalanceView.description: Own available KVN asset 1 balance, excluding locked escrow.

ExecutionOutcome.description: Execution outcome is distinct from finality. Failed finalization is not business success.

nonce.description: Unsigned 64-bit integer. Clients must preserve exact JSON integers; do not round values above JavaScript Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER.

oneOf.description: Unsigned 64-bit integer. Clients must preserve exact JSON integers; do not round values above JavaScript Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER.
Unsigned 64-bit integer. Clients must preserve exact JSON integers; do not round values above JavaScript Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER.

OperationView.description: Poll independently of SSE. Domain failure codes appear here or in receipt.outcome, after the original HTTP 202. Only owner can read.

ApiError.description: Stable machine-readable error code and sanitized human message. Never includes passwords, tokens, seeds, or signing bytes.

cursor.description: Unsigned 64-bit integer. Clients must preserve exact JSON integers; do not round values above JavaScript Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER.

DomainEvent.description: Provider cursor is scoped to its instance and is not the browser notification cursor.

notificationId.description: Unsigned 64-bit integer. Clients must preserve exact JSON integers; do not round values above JavaScript Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER.

NotificationView.description: Session-owned notification. Only explicit read mutation sets readAt; fetching or SSE delivery does not.

nextCursor.description: Unsigned 64-bit integer. Clients must preserve exact JSON integers; do not round values above JavaScript Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER.

NotificationsPage.description: Up to 100 notifications for the session owner. nextCursor is an adapter notification cursor.

WeeklyCommitment.description: Checked aggregate of committed minutes for a week, without project or milestone IDs.

CalendarSummaryView.description: At most one commitment total per week. Does not expose another project's reservation identifiers.

url.description: Absolute HTTPS URL; no credentials, whitespace or control characters. Publicly stored, never fetched.

IndicativeBudget.description: Descriptive legacy USD range. Never converted to KVN or used for funding, matching or escrow.

date.description: Real Gregorian date, year 0001–9999; not a contracted scheduling window.

summary.description: Up to 280 Unicode scalar values; U+0000 is rejected because PostgreSQL JSONB cannot store it.

link.description: Optional absolute HTTP(S) URL without credentials, whitespace or control characters. Limit is UTF-8 bytes; the server never fetches this URL.

objectives.description: Ordered descriptive entries; blank entries and U+0000 are rejected. Empty arrays are permitted.

constraints.description: Ordered descriptive entries; blank entries and U+0000 are rejected. Empty arrays are permitted.

expectedRevision.description: Exact integer; independent of planning/proposal revision. Preserve precision above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER.

revision.description: Exact integer; independent of planning/proposal revision. Preserve precision above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER.

contactEmail.description: Contact address from the worker profile, shared only with authorized participants of this project; null when absent.

description.description: Maximum 2000 UTF-8 bytes; no null bytes.

matchesCurrentDefinition.description: False when the saved business definition differs from the current proposal. Submission/review status alone does not change it.

message.description: Plain text; maximum 10000 UTF-8 bytes; no null bytes.
